scope: New operational guardian and private fixtures only. No real cloud command, supervisor spawn, status/process/ledger modification, training/evaluation retry, or frozen science edit.

allowed: Bound owned gcloud storage cat TimeoutExpired at60s
Observed storage.googleapis.com NameResolutionError on a bound object
rejected: Failed terminal worker or incomplete terminal summary
Stale metric object or failed freshness/viability proof

limitations: Guardian is implemented but not started. Owner review precedes any execution.
Local clock checks cannot execute while the host sleeps; the guardian does not claim hard awake wall-clock enforcement. Existing absolute provider DELETE deadlines independently cap cloud runtime.
A failed or ambiguous recovery halts; it never retries a training/evaluation worker.

independent_review.scope: Read-only source review and private synthetic tests; no live cloud or supervisor action.
